Independents running for Congress
~200
Nearly 200 independent candidates are running in more than 100 House races this fall, NPR counts, trying to prove there's room outside the two parties. Their odds of winning are very low.

✶The National Wire✶

1

Agents Search Rep. Ilhan Omar's Home

Homeland Security agents searched the Minnesota Democrat's Washington home Monday; sources tell CBS the long-running probe concerns immigration paperwork her late father filled out when she was a child. Omar, a U.S. citizen, called it an attempt to target political enemies.

2

Deadly Roller Coaster Accident in Georgia

One rider died and several were hurt Monday on a coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia. Aerial footage showed the train stuck on the track as riders were helped off.

3

Houthis Warn the U.S.

The Iran-backed group in Yemen is threatening a "painful" response if the U.S. joins Saudi Arabia's fight against it. President Trump is weighing strikes after deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi airports.

4

Ship Sunk in Black Sea Drone Attack

Eleven crew members are missing after a merchant ship sank overnight. Bulgaria's prime minister summoned Russia's ambassador.

☑ The Ballot · 21 days to Election Day · early voting opens in 11 days, Oct 24, the same day registration closes

⛪The Home Wire⛪

1

Rochester · Wegmans Closing Amore

Wegmans will close its Amore restaurant on East Avenue by the end of the month. The company said no amount of marketing or investment would have brought in enough customers.

2

Pomfret · Another Battery Storage Plan

RWE Clean Energy wants to build a battery energy storage system near the electric substation in Laona. Company representatives introduced the proposal at a Pomfret Town Board meeting.

★The Marquee★

1

RJ Mitte Dies at 34

He played Walter White Jr. on Breaking Bad, the Emmy-winning drama. Mitte lived with cerebral palsy, as his character did.

2

High Potential Gets the Super Bowl Slot

The drama gets the coveted slot right after the Super Bowl, on ABC and Disney+. It was already the network's most-watched series.

3

It's a Wonderful Life at 80

An 80th-anniversary box set brings a 4K remaster and keepsakes for the 1946 film. The Christmas classic is now counted among the best movies ever made.

🏈The Gridiron🏈

Bills 37, Rams 34 (OT)
How it went. A shootout in Los Angeles. Josh Allen ran for one touchdown, threw for another to Keon Coleman and finished with 331 total yards; James Cook scored twice on the ground, the second a 5-yard run that put Buffalo up 34–27 with 1:44 left. The Rams tied it on a 1-yard Kyren Williams run with eight seconds to go. In overtime the Bills fumbled deep in Rams territory, but Greg Rousseau blocked a Rams field goal, and Tyler Bass hit from 45 with 1:55 left to win it.
Got right: 234 rushing yards, and Bass made all three of his field goals. To fix: 13 penalties for 112 yards, and a defense that let Matthew Stafford complete 40 of 54 passes and the Rams hold the ball for nearly 38 minutes. Buffalo is 4–1. At Las Vegas Sunday, 4:25.
Jets · Riding Sunday's win into Foxborough. The Jets are 2–3; a second straight win would pull them to .500 against a 3–2 Patriots team. Sunday, 1:00.
